### Which tests are flaking?

`k8s.io/kubernetes/test/integration/apiserver - TestPodSubresourceAuth`

### Since when has it been flaking?

Triage tool shows the earliest failures on [2034427434341765120 3/19/2026, 6:01:43 AM](https://prow.k8s.io/view/gs/kubernetes-ci-logs/logs/ci-kubernetes-integration-arm64-master/2034427434341765120) as per [Link](https://storage.googleapis.com/k8s-triage/index.html?text=TestPodSubresourceAuth&test=k8s.io%2Fkubernetes%2Ftest%2Fintegration%2Fapiserver%20&xjob=s3).

### Testgrid link

https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-release-master-blocking#integration-master 

### Reason for failure (if possible)

```
Failed
=== RUN   TestPodSubresourceAuth/subresource=exec
    subresource_auth_test.go:173: expected nil error for user with 'create' permissions, but got: pods "test-pod" is forbidden: User "pod-creator" cannot get resource "pods/exec" in API group "" in the namespace "test-pod-subresource-auth"

=== RUN   TestPodSubresourceAuth
--- FAIL: TestPodSubresourceAuth (3.26s)
```

### Anything else we need to know?

We were able to reproduce this flake locally using stress tool.
Steps to reproduce:

1. Install stress tool (# go install golang.org/x/tools/cmd/stress@latest).
2. Clone the k8s repo (git clone https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes.git).
3. cd kubernetes
4. hack/install-etcd.sh
5. export the output from above command (For example, export PATH="${PATH}:/root/kubernetes/third_party/etcd")
6. etcd &
5. go test ./test/integration/apiserver/ -c -count=1
6. /root/go/bin/stress ./apiserver.test -test.run TestPodSubresourceAuth

